candidates.name: TUTULMA
candidates.detail: Sheet label "G05 / TUTULMA". Companion: one SOLID dark filled disk, no orbit lines, crossed by a narrow asymmetrical bright curved slit from lower-left to upper-right; slit is pale mint fading to icy white with a tiny restrained local glow, rendered as a flat 2D SVG shape. Disk has a faint illuminated crescent edge on one side only. This is a graphic eclipse mark, NOT a planet or glossy physical sphere. Composer almost black with generously rounded 20px corners, no complete border; only a tiny mint slit-shaped status accent at left and mint send arrow right. User messages short unframed pale text aligned right, assistant reply inside one modest dark mint-tinted pill aligned left with a tiny slit emblem. No outlined rectangular cards on every message. Clean quiet conversational hierarchy, fluid and compact.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fresh sophisticated 2D desktop AI assistant design, not generic chatbot UI. Landscape 1536x1024, flat charcoal desktop background #1C1E23, NO physical surface, NO floor, NO studio scene, NO reflections on the background, NO photographic object, no table. All graphics are implementable using SVG paths, CSS gradients, transforms, opacity. Small expressive geometric companion (~64px high) directly next to one compact text composer (~360px wide, 48px high). Be imaginative with precise silhouette and visual hierarchy. Avoid previous rejected motifs: NO concentric rings, NO triangular origami pieces, NO connected-node constellation, NO equalizer bars, NO robots, NO pixel art, NO planet, NO photoreal prism. UI interaction: on click only composer opens; messages then float individually above it, newest nearest input. Never wrap in a large chat panel. TWO states side by side: left labeled "İlk açılış" has only companion and composer, right labeled "Konuşurken" has same elements plus three independent messages. Exact message text "GitHub’ı aç.", "GitHub açıldı.", "Bir de Spotify’ı aç."; composer placeholder "Bir şey yaz..." with a small send arrow. Plain contemporary sans-serif, highly legible text, no extra dashboard or controls. Companion in each state must remain a SMALL interface object, not hero illustration. Keep state clusters centered vertically in lower half of canvas, extensive empty desktop above. Muted saturated accents, subtle local illumination allowed as 2D radial gradients but no bloom across text, no complex visual effects. No logo text within actual UI, only small sheet ID top-left as specified. Communicate elegance through restraint and striking form. Each companion and UI must clearly belong to same visual family.

candidates.name: SERIT
candidates.detail: Sheet label "G06 / SERIT". Companion: a single continuous thick S-shaped flat ribbon with offset open ends, about 60px tall, like a sophisticated calligraphic glyph made of two interlocking wide curved bands; warm pale apricot and coral color divisions, mild 2D linear gradient only. No closed ring, no triangular forms, no 3D ribbon sculpture. Distinct sinuous asymmetric silhouette. Composer a LIGHT warm off-white horizontal shape with one corner softly scooped inward echoing ribbon, dark brown clean text, restrained coral send icon. User messages small warm pale-gray rounded bubbles with dark text aligned right; assistant reply a dark terracotta fill with pale text aligned left. No bubble tails, no outline strokes. Delicate typography and 16px gaps, friendly but polished soft geometry.

candidates.name: KATMAN
candidates.detail: Sheet label "G07 / KATMAN". Companion: two slightly offset flat rounded SQUARE tiles, each around 40px, one behind the other, front tile dark indigo and back tile pale periwinkle; separated by 7px translation, subtle 2D gradient at exposed edge. Front has one tiny white horizontal glint near top-right, no face, glyph, text or >_. Simple graphic layered window-like geometry, no perspective and no 3D extruded object. Composer is a narrow dark navy rectangular strip with 7px rounded corners and a small periwinkle SQUARE send button. Messages are flat independent dark translucent slate strips with small offset lower-left accent tabs echoing companion; user text right aligned, assistant reply pale blue-gray surface with dark text. No thick outlines, no glow. Compact architectural visual rhythm, cool palette, precise asymmetric tab details.

candidates.name: CEKIRDEK
candidates.detail: Sheet label "G08 / CEKIRDEK". Companion: a softly asymmetric four-lobed filled shape, like a rounded plus pinched into a living cushion, smooth SVG contour, not four separate circles. Rich muted berry #A477AB with a small cream elliptical highlight in upper lobe via subtle flat radial gradient. No eyes, no metallic material, no 3D volume, no round orb. A gentle shape that can breathe by morphing its four rounded lobes. Composer uniquely just a thin softly curved underlining stroke, NO filled box, pale cream placeholder above, tiny berry send arrow. Conversation messages ABOVE are small independent translucent aubergine softly rounded shapes with no borders; short user messages align right and assistant left, small offwhite dot signifies assistant. Typography delicate warm white, no purple outline cage, no multiple buttons. Organic approachable futuristic character and airy UI, clearly distinct from circles, panels and linear icons.
